notes: Stay in Ao Nang (Railay is pricey, Krabi Town is quiet). The Railay longtail costs 100 THB; use Grab or a scooter. The airport minibus is 150.
November to April is the dry season: 30°C and glassy seas (the best time). December to February is crowded and expensive, and April brings Songkran.
Fill in the TDAC digital arrival card; carry cash in THB. Island tours cost 1,000-2,500 plus a 400 park fee; a taverna meal is 200-400; round up your tips.
Do Tiger Cave at 07:00 (heat and monkeys), take the 08:00 slot at Maya Bay, and expect the Four Islands to be crowded at midday. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and water shoes.
You will get wet on the morning longtail (bring a dry bag); there are few ATMs in Railay.
Southern Thai food: massaman, gaeng som (sour curry), roti and coconut seafood. Muslim villages serve halal food.

stops.name: Railay West Beach
stops.tips: 15 minutes by longtail boat from Ao Nang (100 THB). A beach between limestone cliffs, quiet in the morning and a hub for rock climbing.

stops.name: Phra Nang Cave Beach
stops.tips: In the rainy season the morning can be sunny, but expect waves.

stops.name: Railay Viewpoint & Lagoon
stops.tips: A red-earth rope climb (short but steep) leads to the view. Going down to the lagoon takes nerve.

stops.name: Mangrove Restaurant Railay East
stops.tips: Thai food by the mangroves; try the green curry.

stops.name: Ao Nang Sunset Wang Sai
stops.tips: Seafood at the far end of Ao Nang. Watch the sunset, then take the 17:30 longtail back.

backups.name: Tonsai Beach
backups.tips: A hippie climbers' beach. Walk there at low tide; choose it for the scenery.

backups.name: Krua Thara Seafood Klong Muang
backups.tips: A local seafood favourite in Klong Muang.

stops.name: Four Islands Tour Ao Nang
stops.tips: Longtail (1,000) or speedboat (1,500); the national park fee of 400 is extra.

stops.name: Koh Poda
stops.tips: White sand and a towering rock. Snorkel here; it is Ao Nang's postcard view.

stops.name: Chicken Island Koh Gai
stops.tips: A rock shaped like a chicken's head; snorkel among the fish.

stops.name: Koh Tup Sandbar Lunch
stops.tips: At low tide a sandbar (Talay Waek) joins three islands. Lunch with rice is included.

stops.name: Phra Nang Cave Beach & Return
stops.tips: The last stop is Phra Nang; you are back in Ao Nang at 16:00.

backups.name: Hong Island Tour
backups.tips: Hong's lagoon and 360° views, as an alternative to the Four Islands (unless you are going the next day).

backups.name: Ao Nang Night Market
backups.tips: A night market from Friday to Sunday; try pad thai and mango sticky rice.

stops.name: Hong Island Speedboat
stops.tips: 30 minutes from Ao Nang, in Than Bok Khorani National Park.

stops.name: Hong Lagoon
stops.tips: A hidden lagoon ringed by cliffs; go by kayak.

stops.name: Koh Hong Main Beach
stops.tips: White sand and coral, plus a 360° viewing platform (419 steps, new in 2019).

stops.name: Koh Hong Picnic Lunch
stops.tips: Included in the tour; eaten on the beach.

stops.name: Koh Lao Lading & Pakbia
stops.tips: A small cove on Paradise Island; snorkel, then head back at 16:00.

backups.name: Krabi Town Chao Fah Night Market
backups.tips: Riverside evening food stalls in Krabi Town.

backups.name: Tup Kaek Beach
backups.tips: If you skip the tour: a quiet beach north of Ao Nang, good for sunset.

stops.name: Tiger Cave Temple Wat Tham Suea
stops.tips: 1,260 steps (steep!) to a summit Buddha and 360° panorama. Go at 07:00 when it is cool; watch for monkeys and bring water.

stops.name: Krabi Town Breakfast Ruen Mai
stops.tips: A garden restaurant serving Thai and southern dishes.

stops.name: Emerald Pool Sa Morakot
stops.tips: An emerald-green natural pool in the forest (1 km wooden walkway) in Khao Phra Bang Khram, 1 hour by car.

stops.name: Blue Pool
stops.tips: A blue spring where swimming is banned, 800 m beyond the Emerald Pool.

stops.name: Klong Thom Hot Springs
stops.tips: Hot spring pools at 40°C in a forest stream, with a waterfall.

backups.name: Khao Khanab Nam Caves
backups.tips: Longtail from Krabi Town; caves and mangroves between two rock hills, instead of the pools.

backups.name: Ko Klang Village Lunch
backups.tips: Home cooking in a Muslim fishing village; arrive by boat.

stops.name: Phi Phi Speedboat Ao Nang
stops.tips: 45 minutes by speedboat (tour about 2,500 THB); the national park fee is 400.

stops.name: Maya Bay
stops.tips: The bay from the film The Beach. Access has been restricted since 2022 (no walking on the beach, no swimming). It is empty at 08:00-09:00 and CLOSED in August and September.

stops.name: Pileh Lagoon & Viking Cave
stops.tips: Swim in the emerald lagoon; see the swiftlet nest cave from outside.

stops.name: Phi Phi Don Tonsai Lunch
stops.tips: Buffet included in the tour, in the island village.

stops.name: Bamboo Island
stops.tips: White sand and snorkelling; head back at 16:30.

backups.name: Phi Phi Viewpoint
backups.tips: The classic view over two bays, a 20-minute climb. Do it instead of Bamboo.

stops.name: Klong Muang Beach
stops.tips: Ao Nang's quiet neighbour; a resort beach for swimming.

stops.name: Tub Kaek Beach
stops.tips: An empty beach with views of the Hong islands, and the start of the Dragon Crest (Khao Ngon Nak) trail.

stops.name: Lae Lay Grill
stops.tips: A well-known hilltop Thai restaurant with sea views, in Ao Nang.

stops.name: Thai Cooking Class Ya's Krabi
stops.tips: A half-day cooking course with a market visit and 5 dishes.

backups.name: Khao Ngon Nak Dragon Crest
backups.tips: A 3.7 km forest climb with cliff-top rock views, instead of the beach.

backups.name: Jenna's Bistro Ao Nang
backups.tips: Thai and Western food; an evening option instead of the course.

days.theme: Ao Nang morning and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Ao Nang Beach Morning Walk
stops.tips: Morning longtails on the sand; the Monkey Trail leads to Pai Plong beach.

stops.name: Pai Plong Beach
stops.tips: A cove by the Centara resort; snorkel and look out for monkeys.

stops.name: Café 8.98 Ao Nang
stops.tips: Breakfast and coffee for your farewell.

stops.name: Krabi Airport Minibus
stops.tips: 40 minutes from Ao Nang; time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Ao Nang Landmark Night Market Morning
backups.tips: For souvenirs, instead of the beach.
